messages:
Marta (Design): Uploaded quick comp for frame-level annotations. Two questions: gutter overlay vs inline row, and export semantics. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/trace-annotations

Ryan (Design): Prefer gutter overlay to avoid layout shift on long stacks. Show icon-only in compact and icon+label in wide view.

Sam (Eng): Overlay works if we keep DOM order: frame text first, then annotation button. CSS can visually place it in gutter. Also need deterministic focus order for keyboard nav.

Nina (A11y): Agree. Dev checklist: keep logical DOM order; button has aria-label like "Annotation for <fn> — Edit"; announce short summary on frame focus, full details behind an expand control.

Alex (Product): Export: prefer inline annotations in exported JSON/markdown by default for shareability, with an opt-in for separate notes file for programmatic consumers. Modal copy suggestion: "Include annotations (visible in trace)" plus helper: "Personal annotations excluded by default."

Priya (Support): Support request: make exported annotations searchable (plain text) and include author + timestamp. Add small warning about PII in annotations.

Sam (Eng): Proposed export v2 snippet: {"trace_id":"t1","frames":[{"id":"f1","function":"parseHeaders","annotation":{"text":"likely missing cookie","author":"marta","ts":"2026-03-20T18:00:00Z","visibility":"team"}}]} — will version this. Flag: include_personal_annotations=false.

Marta (Design): Copy debate: "Annotation" vs "Hypothesis" vs "Note". Proposal: label UI as "Annotation" and surface an optional type inside editor (hypothesis/observation/action).

Nina (A11y): Good compromise. Also add keyboard shortcut 'N' to add note to focused frame and ensure focus ring is visible.

Alex (Product): I'll add visibility options (personal/team/org) in export modal and default to team.

Marta (Design): Action items: Ryan update comps (gutter overlay + compact icon), Sam prototype export_v2 & flags, Nina draft SR copy and checklist, Priya write support blurb, Alex finalize modal copy. Aria-bot: schedule integration reminder.

Aria-bot: integration window 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC — tag PRs with #trace-annotations.

Marta (Design): Thanks all — unless objections I'll land the "Annotation (type: hypothesis)" label and inline-export default by EOD.
